page.overview:
What is Fourth Sister's double-bladed spinning lightsaber?

The double-bladed spinning lightsaber was wielded by the Inquisitor known as the Fourth Sister. It was similar in appearance to the double-bladed spinning lightsabers wielded by other Imperial Inquisitors. She utilized the lightsaber during her mission to capture Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi, on Daiyu. The lightsaber was abandoned in a cave.

When Lina Graf, a commander within the Alliance to Restore the Republic, infiltrated Fortress Vader on Mustafar wearing the Fourth Sister's stolen armor, the attendant Vaneé eventually realized that Graf was, indeed, not the Inquisitor because she lacked her lightsaber.

The lightsaber was a double-bladed spinning lightsaber owned by the Fourth Sister, a Nogratu member of the Galactic Empire's Inquisitorius. The saber possessed a cylindrical hilt with an emitter ring, forming its disc-hilt. The ring featured a notch with a dull spike in the middle near the ring's blade emitters. The notches were opposite to each other.

In 19 BBY, the Fourth Sister carried the lightsaber on her back in crescent mode within a partially constructed Fortress Inquisitorius, the headquarters of the Inquisitors. There, she walked through through a hallway into the fortress's audience chamber after being welcomed in by the Grand Inquisitor, the leader of the Inquisitors. Inside the audience chamber, along with fellow Inquisitors the First Brother, Eleventh Brother, and Barriss Offee, she met the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader, the Inquisitors' new Master.
